description: A3: selective evidence-gated holds (PBTI-SH, no timeout; PBTI-SH-T30, 30 s timeout) versus PBTI, B5 (historical and event-driven review), B5s and PBTI-R on a joint equivocation x suppression grid {0, 1, 5, 10} % plus delayed successors (long delay 1, 5, 10 % with 5 % equivocation) and long suppression runs (20 messages, 1 and 5 % with 5 % equivocation); 120 s production, 180 s drain. Fresh confirmatory seeds 21-40 (the rule was designed after inspecting V3 factorial seeds 1-5).
